subgoals: Divide a by b for quotient and remainder
Replace the pair by b and the remainder

visual.title: Euclid stops at zero
visual.caption: Each row replaces the pair by the divisor and the remainder. The last nonzero remainder is the greatest common divisor.

predict.question: What is the greatest common divisor of 30 and 17?
predict.explain: 30 = 1 times 17 + 13, 17 = 1 times 13 + 4, and the chain ends at 1.
